paragraphs.text: Thou therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.original: Σὺ οὖν, τέκνον μου, ἐνδυναμοῦ ἐν τῇ χάριτι τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Sy oun, teknon mou, endynamou en tē chariti tē en Christō Iēsou,

paragraphs.text: And the things which thou hast heard from me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἃ ἤκουσας παρʼ ἐμοῦ διὰ πολλῶν μαρτύρων, ταῦτα παράθου πιστοῖς ἀνθρώποις, οἵτινες ἱκανοὶ ἔσονται καὶ ἑτέρους διδάξαι.
paragraphs.translit: kai ha ēkousas parʼ emou dia pollōn martyrōn, tauta parathou pistois anthrōpois, hoitines hikanoi esontai kai heterous didaxai.

paragraphs.text: Suffer hardship with [me], as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.original: συγκακοπάθησον ὡς καλὸς στρατιώτης Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: synkakopathēson hōs kalos stratiōtēs Christou Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: No soldier on service entangleth himself in the affairs of [this] life; that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
paragraphs.original: οὐδεὶς στρατευόμενος ἐμπλέκεται ταῖς τοῦ βίου πραγματείαις, ἵνα τῷ στρατολογήσαντι ἀρέσῃ·
paragraphs.translit: oudeis strateuomenos empleketai tais tou biou pragmateiais, hina tō stratologēsanti aresē·

paragraphs.text: And if also a man contend in the games, he is not crowded, except he have contended lawfully.
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ ἀθλῇ τις, οὐ στεφανοῦται ἐὰν μὴ νομίμως ἀθλήσῃ·
paragraphs.translit: ean de kai athlē tis, ou stephanoutai ean mē nomimōs athlēsē·

paragraphs.text: The husbandmen that laboreth must be the first to partake of the fruits.
paragraphs.original: τὸν κοπιῶντα γεωργὸν δεῖ πρῶτον τῶν καρπῶν μεταλαμβάνειν.
paragraphs.translit: ton kopiōnta geōrgon dei prōton tōn karpōn metalambanein.

paragraphs.text: Consider what I say; for the Lord shall give thee understanding in all things.
paragraphs.original: νόει ὃ λέγω· δώσει γάρ σοι ὁ κύριος σύνεσιν ἐν πᾶσιν.
paragraphs.translit: noei ho legō· dōsei gar soi ho kyrios synesin en pasin.

paragraphs.text: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my gospel:
paragraphs.original: Μνημόνευε Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐγηγερμένον ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐκ σπέρματος Δαυίδ, κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου·
paragraphs.translit: Mnēmoneue Iēsoun Christon egēgermenon ek nekrōn, ek spermatos Dauid, kata to euangelion mou·

paragraphs.text: wherein I suffer hardship unto bonds, as a malefactor; but the word of God is not bound.
paragraphs.original: ἐν ᾧ κακοπαθῶ μέχρι δεσμῶν ὡς κακοῦργος. ἀλλὰ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ οὐ δέδεται·
paragraphs.translit: en hō kakopathō mechri desmōn hōs kakourgos. alla ho logos tou theou ou dedetai·

paragraphs.text: Therefore I endure all things for the elect`s sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
paragraphs.original: διὰ τοῦτο πάντα ὑπομένω διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς, ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ σωτηρίας τύχωσιν τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ μετὰ δόξης αἰωνίου.
paragraphs.translit: dia touto panta hypomenō dia tous eklektous, hina kai autoi sōtērias tychōsin tēs en Christō Iēsou meta doxēs aiōniou.

paragraphs.text: Faithful is the saying: For if we died with him, we shall also live with him:
paragraphs.original: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος· εἰ γὰρ συναπεθάνομεν, καὶ συζήσομεν·
paragraphs.translit: pistos ho logos· ei gar synapethanomen, kai syzēsomen·

paragraphs.text: if we endure, we shall also reign with him: if we shall deny him, he also will deny us:
paragraphs.original: εἰ ὑπομένομεν, καὶ συμβασιλεύσομεν· εἰ ἀρνησόμεθα, κἀκεῖνος ἀρνήσεται ἡμᾶς·
paragraphs.translit: ei hypomenomen, kai symbasileusomen· ei arnēsometha, kakeinos arnēsetai hēmas·

paragraphs.text: if we are faithless, he abideth faithful; for he cannot deny himself.
paragraphs.original: εἰ ἀπιστοῦμεν, ἐκεῖνος πιστὸς μένει· ἀρνήσασθαι ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται.
paragraphs.translit: ei apistoumen, ekeinos pistos menei· arnēsasthai heauton ou dynatai.

paragraphs.text: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging [them] in the sight of the Lord, that they strive not about words, to no profit, to the subverting of them that hear.
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτα ὑπομίμνῃσκε, διαμαρτυρόμενος ἐνώπιον τοῦ κυρίου, μὴ λογομαχεῖν, ἐπʼ οὐδὲν χρήσιμον, ἐπὶ καταστροφῇ τῶν ἀκουόντων.
paragraphs.translit: Tauta hypomimnēske, diamartyromenos enōpion tou kyriou, mē logomachein, epʼ ouden chrēsimon, epi katastrophē tōn akouontōn.

paragraphs.text: Give diligence to present thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, handling aright the word of truth.
paragraphs.original: σπούδασον σεαυτὸν δόκιμον παραστῆσαι τῷ θεῷ, ἐργάτην ἀνεπαίσχυντον, ὀρθοτομοῦντα τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας.
paragraphs.translit: spoudason seauton dokimon parastēsai tō theō, ergatēn anepaischynton, orthotomounta ton logon tēs alētheias.

paragraphs.text: But shun profane babblings: for they will proceed further in ungodliness,
paragraphs.original: τὰς δὲ βεβήλους κενοφωνίας περιΐστασο· ἐπὶ πλεῖον γὰρ προκόψουσιν ἀσεβείας,
paragraphs.translit: tas de bebēlous kenophōnias periistaso· epi pleion gar prokopsousin asebeias,

paragraphs.text: and their word will eat as doth a gangrene: or whom is Hymenaeus an Philetus;
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτῶν ὡς γάγγραινα νομὴν ἕξει· ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Φίλητος,
paragraphs.translit: kai ho logos autōn hōs gangraina nomēn hexei· hōn estin Hymenaios kai Philētos,

paragraphs.text: men who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already, and overthrow the faith of some.
paragraphs.original: οἵτινες περὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἠστόχησαν, λέγοντες ἀνάστασιν ἤδη γεγονέναι, καὶ ἀνατρέπουσιν τήν τινων πίστιν.
paragraphs.translit: hoitines peri tēn alētheian ēstochēsan, legontes anastasin ēdē gegonenai, kai anatrepousin tēn tinōn pistin.

paragraphs.text: Howbeit the firm foundation of God standeth, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his: and, Let every one that nameth the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.
paragraphs.original: ὁ μέντοι στερεὸς θεμέλιος τοῦ θεοῦ ἕστηκεν, ἔχων τὴν σφραγῖδα ταύτην· Ἔγνω κύριος τοὺς ὄντας αὐτοῦ, καί· Ἀποστήτω ἀπὸ ἀδικίας πᾶς ὁ ὀνομάζων τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου.
paragraphs.translit: ho mentoi stereos themelios tou theou hestēken, echōn tēn sphragida tautēn· Egnō kyrios tous ontas autou, kai· Apostētō apo adikias pas ho onomazōn to onoma kyriou.

paragraphs.text: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some unto honor, and some unto dishonor.
paragraphs.original: Ἐν μεγάλῃ δὲ οἰκίᾳ οὐκ ἔστιν μόνον σκεύη χρυσᾶ καὶ ἀργυρᾶ ἀλλὰ καὶ ξύλινα καὶ ὀστράκινα, καὶ ἃ μὲν εἰς τιμὴν ἃ δὲ εἰς ἀτιμίαν·
paragraphs.translit: En megalē de oikia ouk estin monon skeuē chrysa kai argyra alla kai xylina kai ostrakina, kai ha men eis timēn ha de eis atimian·

paragraphs.text: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honor, sanctified, meet for the master`s use, prepared unto every good work.
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν οὖν τις ἐκκαθάρῃ ἑαυτὸν ἀπὸ τούτων, ἔσται σκεῦος εἰς τιμήν, ἡγιασμένον, εὔχρηστον τῷ δεσπότῃ, εἰς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἡτοιμασμένον.
paragraphs.translit: ean oun tis ekkatharē heauton apo toutōn, estai skeuos eis timēn, hēgiasmenon, euchrēston tō despotē, eis pan ergon agathon hētoimasmenon.

paragraphs.text: after righteousness, faith, love, pace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
paragraphs.original: τὰς δὲ νεωτερικὰς ἐπιθυμίας φεῦγε, δίωκε δὲ δικαιοσύνην, πίστιν, ἀγάπην, εἰρήνην μετὰ τῶν ἐπικαλουμένων τὸν κύριον ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας.
paragraphs.translit: tas de neōterikas epithymias pheuge, diōke de dikaiosynēn, pistin, agapēn, eirēnēn meta tōn epikaloumenōn ton kyrion ek katharas kardias.

paragraphs.text: But foolish and ignorant questionings refuse, knowing that they gender strifes.
paragraphs.original: τὰς δὲ μωρὰς καὶ ἀπαιδεύτους ζητήσεις παραιτοῦ, εἰδὼς ὅτι γεννῶσι μάχας·
paragraphs.translit: tas de mōras kai apaideutous zētēseis paraitou, eidōs hoti gennōsi machas·

paragraphs.text: And the Lord`s servant must not strive, but be gentle towards all, apt to teach, forbearing,
paragraphs.original: δοῦλον δὲ κυρίου οὐ δεῖ μάχεσθαι, ἀλλὰ ἤπιον εἶναι πρὸς πάντας, διδακτικόν, ἀνεξίκακον,
paragraphs.translit: doulon de kyriou ou dei machesthai, alla ēpion einai pros pantas, didaktikon, anexikakon,

paragraphs.text: in meekness correcting them that oppose themselves; if peradventure God may give them repentance unto the knowledge of the truth,
paragraphs.original: ἐν πραΰτητι παιδεύοντα τοὺς ἀντιδιατιθεμένους, μήποτε δώῃ αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς μετάνοιαν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας,
paragraphs.translit: en prautēti paideuonta tous antidiatithemenous, mēpote dōē autois ho theos metanoian eis epignōsin alētheias,

paragraphs.text: and they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, having been taken captive by him unto his will.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀνανήψωσιν ἐκ τῆς τοῦ διαβόλου παγίδος, ἐζωγρημένοι ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἐκείνου θέλημα.
paragraphs.translit: kai ananēpsōsin ek tēs tou diabolou pagidos, ezōgrēmenoi hypʼ autou eis to ekeinou thelēma.
